exercises.prompt: Explica un malentendido por ironía en una reunión: describe el contexto, aclara la intención y ajusta el registro.
exercises.modelAnswer: In the meeting, I said that the schedule was ambitious, but I meant it ironically because we had already missed two deadlines. That said, I should have read the room: the new colleague took my comment literally. In other words, the tone was too subtle for a formal setting, so I clarified that I was criticising the plan, not the team.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo explica la ironía, reconoce el efecto literal y reformula con marcadores.

lessons.title: Rebatir con evidencia
lessons.scenario: Alguien defiende una afirmación con datos incompletos y hay que responder con rigor.
lessons.canDo: Puedo evaluar una fuente, señalar sesgos y rebatir con datos sin sonar dogmático.

grammarPoints.label: Passive reporting structures
grammarPoints.description: It is said that…, He is believed to…

grammarPoints.label: Inversion with negative adverbials
grammarPoints.description: Not only…, Under no circumstances…, Rarely…

culturalNotes.idiom: take it with a grain of salt
culturalNotes.note: Recibir una información con escepticismo razonable; no equivale a rechazarla por completo.

exercises.passage: Not only {{b1}} the data incomplete, but the sample {{b2}} also too small.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Tras 'Not only' se invierte el auxiliar: 'Not only were the data…'; 'sample' es singular.

exercises.passage: It {{b1}} that the figure was exaggerated; under no circumstances {{b2}} we present it as fact before {{b3}} it.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La pasiva reportativa atribuye la afirmación y la inversión negativa refuerza la prohibición.

exercises.instructions: Clasifica cada valoración de la evidencia.

pairs.left: The claim is based on a single source.
pairs.nuance: Un solo origen no permite generalizar.

pairs.left: The sample is representative.
pairs.nuance: El grupo refleja la población estudiada.

pairs.left: The statistic is misleading.
pairs.nuance: La cifra existe, pero induce a error.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Distinguir fuente, muestra y presentación evita confundir un dato con una conclusión.

exercises.instructions: Distingue el tono de cada réplica.

pairs.left: That may be true, but the evidence is incomplete.
pairs.nuance: Concede sin aceptar la conclusión.

pairs.left: Rarely have I seen such a biased sample.
pairs.nuance: La inversión intensifica el reproche.

pairs.left: I'd take that figure with a grain of salt.
pairs.nuance: Duda sin rechazar por completo.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La inversión y el modismo cambian la intensidad del escepticismo.

exercises.audioText: The report is said to be independent, but its funding comes from the company it evaluates.
exercises.question: What is the problem?
options: The report may not be independent

feedbackOnError.explanation: El conflicto de interés cuestiona la independencia que se le atribuye al informe.

exercises.audioText: Not only was the statistic taken out of context, but the sample excluded half the participants. I'd suggest we verify the source before repeating the claim.
exercises.question: What should they do before repeating the claim?

feedbackOnError.explanation: La doble objeción lleva a la recomendación de verificar la fuente antes de difundir la cifra.

exercises.question: Completa: Under no circumstances ___ we ignore the source of the data.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La inversión negativa coloca el modal antes del sujeto: 'Under no circumstances should we…'.

exercises.transcription: Not only was the sample small but the source was also biased
exercises.audioText: Not only was the sample small but the source was also biased

feedbackOnError.explanation: Escribe 'biased' con 's' intermedia y recuerda la inversión 'was the sample'.

exercises.targetPhrase: I'd take that figure with a grain of salt.
exercises.audioText: I'd take that figure with a grain of salt.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Enlaza 'take that figure' y pronuncia con claridad 'grain of salt'.

exercises.prompt: Rebate una afirmación basada en datos incompletos: evalúa la fuente, señala el sesgo y propone cómo verificarla.
exercises.modelAnswer: It is said that the survey proves the policy works, but I'd take that claim with a grain of salt. Not only was the sample self-selected, but the questions were misleading. Under no circumstances should we present the result as representative until an independent source verifies the methodology and the raw data.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo combina pasiva reportativa, inversión negativa y escepticismo moderado.

lessons.title: Llegar a un acuerdo
lessons.scenario: Dos posturas enfrentadas deben converger en una propuesta común para presentar al equipo.
lessons.canDo: Puedo mediar entre posturas, reformular concesiones y redactar una conclusión compartida.

grammarPoints.label: Subjunctive mood
grammarPoints.description: I suggest that he be…, It is essential that…

grammarPoints.label: Hedging
grammarPoints.description: I'm afraid, it seems, perhaps, would.

culturalNotes.note: Ceder parcialmente para alcanzar un acuerdo; implica movimiento de ambas partes, no solo de una.

exercises.passage: It is essential that every voice {{b1}} heard before we {{b2}} a final decision.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Tras 'It is essential that' se usa el subjuntivo 'be'; el verbo principal va en presente tras 'before we'.

exercises.passage: I suggest that the team {{b1}} the proposal, and it is vital that we {{b2}} the objections before {{b3}} the agreement.

feedbackOnError.explanation: El subjuntivo mantiene la forma base tras 'suggest that' e 'it is vital that'; tras preposición se usa gerundio.

exercises.instructions: Empareja cada intervención con su función en la mediación.

pairs.left: It is important that both sides feel heard.
pairs.nuance: Prioriza el proceso sobre el resultado.

pairs.left: I'm afraid we're talking past each other.
pairs.nuance: El problema es la escucha, no la postura.

pairs.left: Let's meet halfway.
pairs.nuance: Propone un intercambio equilibrado.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La mediación nombra el problema de comunicación y propone una concesión recíproca.

exercises.instructions: Distingue el grado de compromiso de cada propuesta.

pairs.left: Would it be possible to revisit the timeline?
pairs.nuance: El condicional evita una imposición.

pairs.left: Perhaps we could settle this informally.
pairs.nuance: Abre una vía sin compromiso.

pairs.left: I'd rather we didn't rush the outcome.
pairs.nuance: Expresa cautela con cortesía.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Los atenuadores permiten proponer sin cerrar la negociación antes de tiempo.

exercises.audioText: I suggest that we address the objection now, before it becomes a reason to delay the agreement.
exercises.question: What does the speaker want to do?

feedbackOnError.explanation: La propuesta es resolver la objeción ahora para que no retrase el acuerdo.

exercises.audioText: It is essential that the team review the proposal, but I'm afraid we shouldn't ask them to decide today. Perhaps we could facilitate a shorter session tomorrow and settle the remaining points then.
exercises.question: What does the speaker propose?

feedbackOnError.explanation: El hablante pide revisar la propuesta y propone una sesión más corta al día siguiente.

exercises.question: Completa: It is vital that she ___ the meeting before we sign.

feedbackOnError.explanation: El subjuntivo tras 'It is vital that' usa la forma base 'attend'.
Tras 'I suggest that' se usa el subjuntivo 'we meet', no 'we met'.

exercises.targetPhrase: Let's meet halfway on the remaining points.
exercises.audioText: Let's meet halfway on the remaining points.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Enlaza 'meet halfway' y baja la entonación para cerrar la propuesta.

exercises.prompt: Media entre dos posturas: reformula una objeción, propón una concesión mutua y cierra con una conclusión compartida.
exercises.modelAnswer: It is essential that both teams feel their objection has been heard. I suggest that we meet halfway: the product team accepts the shorter timeline, and finance provides an additional reviewer. Perhaps we could settle the remaining points in a short session tomorrow so that the final proposal reflects a shared outcome.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo usa el subjuntivo para la propuesta y atenuadores para mantener la negociación abierta.

lessons.title: El día que todo cambió
lessons.scenario: Contar un giro inesperado en una carrera profesional y lo que se aprendió después.
lessons.canDo: Puedo narrar un cambio vital con detalle, ordenar los hechos y reflexionar sobre sus efectos.

grammarPoints.label: Narrative tenses
grammarPoints.description: Pasado simple, continuo y perfecto en relatos.

grammarPoints.label: Mixed conditionals
grammarPoints.description: Condición presente con consecuencia pasada o futura.

culturalNotes.note: De forma totalmente inesperada; se usa para introducir un giro que no se anticipaba.

exercises.passage: I {{b1}} in the office when my manager called; she told me that the project {{b2}} cancelled.

feedbackOnError.explanation: El pasado continuo sitúa la acción interrumpida; el pasado perfecto reporta una decisión anterior.

exercises.passage: If I {{b1}} the opportunity then, I {{b2}} be in this role today, and I sometimes wonder what {{b3}} have happened otherwise.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La mixed conditional conecta una decisión pasada con una consecuencia presente.

exercises.instructions: Empareja cada fragmento con su función narrativa.

pairs.left: Out of the blue, she offered me the role.
pairs.nuance: Rompe la expectativa de la historia.

pairs.left: Looking back, I realise how lucky I was.
pairs.nuance: Interpreta los hechos desde el presente.

pairs.left: Everything happened so fast that I barely slept.
pairs.nuance: Prioriza la sensación de velocidad sobre el detalle.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Los marcadores narrativos orientan al oyente sobre el giro, la reflexión y el ritmo.

exercises.instructions: Distingue la relación temporal de cada estructura.

pairs.left: I had been working there for years when it happened.
pairs.nuance: Prepara el escenario antes del hecho principal.

pairs.left: I was about to leave when the phone rang.
pairs.nuance: El pasado continuo marca la interrupción.

pairs.left: By the time I arrived, the decision had been made.
pairs.nuance: El pasado perfecto sitúa el hecho antes de la llegada.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Cada tiempo verbal ordena los hechos de forma distinta dentro del relato.

exercises.audioText: Out of the blue, my manager offered me a role abroad. I hadn't even applied for it.
exercises.question: What happened unexpectedly?
options: The speaker applied for a role
The speaker was offered a role abroad

feedbackOnError.explanation: El giro es la oferta inesperada de un puesto en el extranjero.

exercises.audioText: I was preparing to leave when the call came. If I had ignored it, I wouldn't be leading this team today.
exercises.question: What does the speaker imply?
options: The call changed the speaker's career

feedbackOnError.explanation: La mixed conditional muestra que responder la llamada cambió su situación actual.

exercises.question: Completa: If I ___ the offer, I wouldn't be here now.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La consecuencia presente exige una condición pasada: 'If I had accepted…'.
El modismo 'out of the blue' se coloca al final del enunciado.

exercises.targetPhrase: Out of the blue, everything changed.
exercises.audioText: Out of the blue, everything changed.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Enlaza 'out of' y da énfasis a 'blue' para marcar el giro.

exercises.prompt: Narra un giro inesperado en tu carrera: ordena los hechos, explica qué cambió y reflexiona con retrospectiva.
exercises.modelAnswer: I was working on a project I disliked when a former colleague called out of the blue. She offered me a role I hadn't applied for. Looking back, that call was the turning point. If I hadn't accepted it, I wouldn't have met the team I now lead, although I sometimes regret not negotiating the salary.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo combina pasados narrativos con una mixed conditional de retrospectiva.

lessons.title: Una decisión que pesa
lessons.scenario: Hay que elegir entre dos ofertas laborales con costes personales distintos.
lessons.canDo: Puedo sopesar opciones, expresar arrepentimiento hipotético y justificar una decisión difícil.

grammarPoints.label: Third conditional
grammarPoints.description: Hipótesis pasadas no realizadas.

grammarPoints.label: Wish / if only
grammarPoints.description: Deseos y arrepentimientos.

culturalNotes.note: Afrontar una decisión difícil y desagradable; sugiere aceptar un coste a cambio de avanzar.

exercises.passage: If I {{b1}} more time, I {{b2}} have taken the job in Berlin.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La third conditional usa 'If I had had… I would have taken…'.

exercises.passage: I wish I {{b1}} more carefully before accepting; if only I {{b2}} asked about the travel, and I {{b3}} not have underestimated the cost.

feedbackOnError.explanation: 'I wish' y 'if only' expresan arrepentimiento con pasado perfecto; 'might not have' especula sobre una consecuencia.

exercises.instructions: Empareja cada expresión con su función en la decisión.

pairs.left: I'm having second thoughts.
pairs.nuance: Reabre una decisión que parecía tomada.

pairs.left: We need to weigh up the risks.
pairs.nuance: Compara costes y beneficios antes de actuar.

pairs.left: I've decided to bite the bullet.
pairs.nuance: Acepta un coste para avanzar.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Las tres expresiones describen momentos distintos del proceso de decisión.

exercises.instructions: Distingue el deseo del arrepentimiento hipotético.

pairs.left: If only I had waited.
pairs.nuance: Lamenta una acción pasada concreta.

pairs.left: I wish I could start over.
pairs.nuance: Imagina una situación que no puede cambiar.

pairs.left: Had I known, I would have negotiated.
pairs.nuance: La inversión sustituye a 'if' y añade énfasis.

feedbackOnError.explanation: 'If only', 'wish' y la inversión 'Had I known' expresan distintos grados de arrepentimiento.

exercises.audioText: I had second thoughts about the offer, but I decided to bite the bullet and accept it.
exercises.question: What did the speaker do?

feedbackOnError.explanation: El hablante tenía dudas, pero aceptó la oferta y afrontó la decisión.

exercises.audioText: If I had known how much travel was involved, I would have asked for a higher salary. I wish I had negotiated harder before signing.
exercises.question: What does the speaker regret?
options: Accepting a lower salary than offered

feedbackOnError.explanation: El arrepentimiento es no haber negociado mejor antes de firmar.

exercises.question: Completa: If she ___ the risks, she wouldn't have accepted.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La tercera condicional exige pasado perfecto en la condición: 'had weighed'.

exercises.transcription: I wish I had asked more questions before accepting the offer
exercises.audioText: I wish I had asked more questions before accepting the offer

feedbackOnError.explanation: Escribe 'questions' con 't' y 'accepting' con doble 'c' y una 'p'.

exercises.targetPhrase: I've decided to bite the bullet and accept.
exercises.audioText: I've decided to bite the bullet and accept.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Enlaza 'bite the bullet' y baja la entonación en 'accept' para cerrar la decisión.

exercises.prompt: Elige entre dos ofertas laborales: sopesa los costes personales, expresa un arrepentimiento hipotético y justifica tu decisión.
exercises.modelAnswer: I'm weighing up a stable job against a more creative role that pays less. If I had more savings, I would have taken the creative offer without hesitation, but I have to consider my family. I wish I didn't have to choose, yet I've decided to bite the bullet and accept the stable role for now.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo combina wish/if only con una tercera condicional para justificar la renuncia.

lessons.title: Contar un malentendido
lessons.scenario: Un mensaje ambiguo provocó una discusión; hay que reconstruir qué dijo cada parte.
lessons.canDo: Puedo reconstruir un diálogo, atribuir palabras con precisión y aclarar una interpretación errónea.

grammarPoints.label: Advanced reported speech
grammarPoints.description: Verbos de habla y desplazamiento de tiempos.

grammarPoints.label: Narrative tenses
grammarPoints.description: Pasado simple, continuo y perfecto en relatos.

culturalNotes.idiom: get the wrong end of the stick
culturalNotes.note: Interpretar algo al revés; se usa cuando alguien entiende lo contrario de lo que se dijo.

exercises.passage: She said she {{b1}} waiting for an answer and asked why I {{b2}} replied.

feedbackOnError.explanation: En reported speech, el pasado perfecto continuo y el pasado perfecto simple desplazan los tiempos originales.

exercises.passage: He told me he {{b1}} the message, but later admitted he {{b2}} it, and we agreed that we {{b3}} clarify it together.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Los hechos anteriores se reportan con pasado perfecto y el acuerdo futuro con 'would'.

exercises.instructions: Empareja cada frase con su función en la aclaración.

pairs.left: That's not what I meant.
pairs.nuance: Corrige la interpretación sin negar los hechos.

pairs.left: You got the wrong end of the stick.
pairs.nuance: Señala que se entendió lo contrario.

pairs.left: Let's clear this up.
pairs.nuance: Propone pasar de la discusión a la solución.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La aclaración distingue intención, interpretación y solución.

exercises.instructions: Distingue qué se reporta en cada estructura.

pairs.left: She said she would call.
pairs.nuance: 'Would' desplaza el futuro original.

pairs.left: He asked whether I had seen it.
pairs.nuance: La pregunta de sí/no usa 'whether'.

pairs.left: They told us not to worry.
pairs.nuance: El imperativo pasa a infinitivo negativo.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Cada verbo de habla exige una estructura distinta al reportar.

exercises.audioText: She said she had sent the file, but I hadn't received it, so we checked the address.
exercises.question: What caused the problem?

feedbackOnError.explanation: Al comprobar la dirección descubren el origen del malentendido.

exercises.audioText: He asked why I hadn't replied, and I explained that I had never seen his message. It turned out that he had sent it to the wrong address.
exercises.question: What happened?
options: The message went to the wrong address

feedbackOnError.explanation: El mensaje se envió a una dirección equivocada, no fue ignorado.

exercises.question: Completa: She asked me where I ___ the file.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La pregunta reportada desplaza el pasado simple a pasado perfecto: 'had seen'.
La pregunta reportada mantiene el orden de afirmación y usa 'had not replied'.

exercises.targetPhrase: Let's clear this up before it gets worse.
exercises.audioText: Let's clear this up before it gets worse.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Enlaza 'clear this up' y marca 'before' para separar la propuesta de la advertencia.

exercises.prompt: Reconstruye un malentendido por mensaje: explica qué dijo cada parte, atribuye las palabras con precisión y aclara la interpretación errónea.
exercises.modelAnswer: She told me she had sent the brief on Monday, and I said I had never received it. I assumed she had forgotten, while she thought I was ignoring her. We checked the messages and realised she had used my old address. We cleared it up by forwarding the file, and I apologised for blaming her too quickly.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo usa reported speech y pasados narrativos para reconstruir el diálogo.

lessons.title: Humor y sarcasmo
lessons.scenario: En una sobremesa alguien bromea y otra persona se lo toma en serio.
lessons.canDo: Puedo distinguir humor de ofensa, aclarar una broma y adaptar el tono a la audiencia.

grammarPoints.label: Register shifts
grammarPoints.description: Formal/informal, atenuación y distancia.

grammarPoints.label: Ellipsis and substitution
grammarPoints.description: so do I, neither did she, one/ones.

culturalNotes.note: Gastar una broma cariñosa, no engañar de verdad; el tono y el contexto indican que no hay intención de dañar.

exercises.passage: I thought the joke was funny, but she {{b1}}, so I apologised and {{b2}} it more clearly.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La elipsis 'she didn't' sustituye a 'didn't find it funny'; el verbo narrativo va en pasado.

exercises.passage: He can be quite deadpan, and so {{b1}} his brother; they both {{b2}} a very dry sense of humour, and neither of them {{b3}} offence easily.

feedbackOnError.explanation: 'So can his brother' usa sustitución con el modal; 'neither of them takes' concuerda en singular.

exercises.instructions: Empareja cada reacción con su intención.

pairs.left: I was just pulling your leg.
pairs.nuance: Aclara que no había intención de ofender.

pairs.left: No offence taken.
pairs.nuance: Cierra la posibilidad de conflicto.

pairs.left: That went down like a lead balloon.
pairs.nuance: La imagen expresa rechazo inmediato del público.

feedbackOnError.explanation: El contexto y el tono distinguen una broma cariñosa de una ofensa real.

exercises.instructions: Distingue qué sustituye cada respuesta breve.

pairs.left: So do I.
pairs.nuance: Sustituye una opinión positiva ya expresada.

pairs.left: Neither did she.
pairs.nuance: Confirma que tampoco ocurrió en su caso.

pairs.left: I thought so.
pairs.nuance: Evita repetir toda la suposición.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La elipsis evita repetir información conocida y mantiene el ritmo de la conversación.

exercises.audioText: I was only pulling your leg; I didn't mean to offend you.
exercises.question: What was the speaker's intention?

feedbackOnError.explanation: El hablante aclara que era una broma y que no pretendía ofender.

exercises.audioText: She told the joke deadpan, so nobody laughed at first. Then someone realised she was being self-deprecating, and the room relaxed.
exercises.question: Why did nobody laugh at first?

feedbackOnError.explanation: El tono neutro de la broma hizo que el público tardara en reconocer el humor.

exercises.question: Completa: I enjoyed the film, and so ___ my sister.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La sustitución con 'so' copia el auxiliar del pasado: 'so did my sister'.

exercises.transcription: I was only pulling your leg so don't take it seriously
exercises.audioText: I was only pulling your leg so don't take it seriously

feedbackOnError.explanation: Escribe 'pulling' con doble 'l' y 'seriously' con 'ous' final.

exercises.targetPhrase: I was only pulling your leg.
exercises.audioText: I was only pulling your leg.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Enlaza 'pulling your' y suaviza el tono para que la aclaración suene cariñosa.

exercises.prompt: Aclara una broma que alguien se tomó en serio: explica la intención, adapta el tono y evita que la otra persona se sienta ofendida.
exercises.modelAnswer: I was only pulling your leg when I said the presentation was disastrous. I didn't mean to offend you, and I'm sorry it landed badly. I thought you would find it funny, but clearly the timing was wrong. Let me explain what I actually meant, and I'll keep the jokes for less stressful moments.
selfAssessmentCriteria: ¿Evité que la persona se sintiera ofendida?

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo aclara la broma, pide disculpas y ajusta el registro para reparar el malentendido.

lessons.title: El hubiera no existe
lessons.scenario: Alguien se lamenta por una oportunidad perdida y hay que ayudarle a cerrar el tema.
lessons.canDo: Puedo consolar con empatía, reformular un arrepentimiento y proponer una perspectiva futura.

grammarPoints.label: Mixed conditionals
grammarPoints.description: Condición presente con consecuencia pasada o futura.

grammarPoints.label: Participle clauses
grammarPoints.description: Having said that…, Faced with…

culturalNotes.idiom: no use crying over spilt milk
culturalNotes.note: Lamentarse no cambia lo ocurrido; se usa para animar a aceptar un hecho y seguir adelante.

exercises.passage: If I {{b1}} so focused on work, I {{b2}} have missed my daughter's concert.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La mixed conditional conecta una condición presente ('weren't so focused') con una consecuencia pasada ('wouldn't have missed').

exercises.passage: Having {{b1}} the opportunity, she decided to move on; looking back, she {{b2}} have handled it differently, but she has {{b3}} learned to accept it.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La participle clause 'Having missed…' indica una causa previa; 'could have handled' expresa una posibilidad pasada.

exercises.instructions: Empareja cada frase con su función emocional.

pairs.left: It's no use crying over spilt milk.
pairs.nuance: Anima a dejar de lamentarse por algo irreversible.

pairs.left: I've made my peace with it.
pairs.nuance: Indica que el conflicto interno se ha resuelto.

pairs.left: That chapter is behind me.
pairs.nuance: Marca distancia y apertura a lo que viene.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Las tres expresiones describen distintas etapas del cierre emocional.

exercises.instructions: Distingue la relación que introduce cada estructura.

pairs.left: Having lost the contract, we reviewed our proposal.
pairs.nuance: La acción anterior explica la revisión.

pairs.left: Faced with the setback, she stayed calm.
pairs.nuance: La participle describe el contexto de la reacción.

pairs.left: Had I known, I would have waited.
pairs.nuance: La inversión sustituye a 'if' en la tercera condicional.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Las participle clauses comprimen causa y contexto; la inversión presenta una hipótesis pasada.

exercises.audioText: It's no use crying over spilt milk. The opportunity is gone, but the lesson isn't.
exercises.question: What is the speaker's message?
options: The lesson is more valuable than regret
The speaker is angry about the milk

feedbackOnError.explanation: El modismo resta valor al lamento y desplaza el foco a la lección aprendida.

exercises.audioText: Having missed the deadline, we had to renegotiate. If we were better organised, we wouldn't have lost the client, but we've learned to move on.
exercises.question: What did the team learn?
options: To move on after a setback

feedbackOnError.explanation: El equipo acepta la pérdida, extrae una lección y decide seguir adelante.

exercises.question: Completa: ___ missed the deadline, we had to apologise.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La participle clause de causa previa se forma con 'Having + participio'.
El modismo fijo es 'It is no use crying over spilt milk'.

exercises.targetPhrase: It's no use crying over spilt milk.
exercises.audioText: It's no use crying over spilt milk.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Enlaza 'no use' y pronuncia 'spilt milk' con claridad al final.

exercises.prompt: Consuela a alguien por una oportunidad perdida: muestra empatía, reformula el arrepentimiento y propón una perspectiva futura.
exercises.modelAnswer: I understand why you keep thinking about the offer you turned down. Having missed that chance, you now see the risks more clearly, but it's no use crying over spilt milk. If you were less hard on yourself, you wouldn't have missed the lessons this experience has taught you. Let's use that perspective for the next opportunity.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo combina una participle clause con una mixed conditional y el modismo de cierre.

lessons.title: Leer entre líneas
lessons.scenario: Un titular sugiere algo que el artículo no afirma; hay que detectar la intención editorial.
lessons.canDo: Puedo analizar un titular, distinguir hecho de interpretación y explicar una omisión.

grammarPoints.label: Passive reporting structures
grammarPoints.description: It is said that…, He is believed to…

grammarPoints.label: Hedging
grammarPoints.description: I'm afraid, it seems, perhaps, would.

culturalNotes.note: Inferir lo que no se dice explícitamente; en prensa ayuda a detectar encuadres y omisiones.

exercises.passage: The article {{b1}} to be based on a single anonymous source, and it {{b2}} not be reliable.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La pasiva reportativa atribuye la información y 'may' introduce cautela sobre su fiabilidad.

exercises.passage: It {{b1}} that the outlet has {{b2}} the story, but {{b3}} we should read between the lines before sharing it.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La pasiva reportativa presenta la versión del medio y 'perhaps' suaviza la recomendación crítica.

exercises.instructions: Empareja cada fenómeno con su descripción periodística.

pairs.left: The headline implies a threat without stating it.
pairs.nuance: Sugiere una conclusión que el texto no afirma.

pairs.left: The article omits the context of the protest.
pairs.nuance: La ausencia de datos cambia la interpretación.

pairs.left: The outlet has a clear editorial spin.
pairs.nuance: El enfoque favorece una posición política.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Insinuación, omisión y sesgo son mecanismos distintos de encuadre informativo.

exercises.instructions: Distingue la interpretación atenuada de la lectura crítica directa.

pairs.left: It could be argued that the timing is political.
pairs.nuance: Presenta la crítica como posibilidad.

pairs.left: The timing is, shall we say, convenient.
pairs.nuance: El eufemismo insinúa una intención.

pairs.left: I'd read between the lines here.
pairs.nuance: Invita a buscar lo no dicho.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La atenuación y la ironía permiten señalar un sesgo sin acusar directamente.

exercises.audioText: The headline says prices are soaring, but the article only mentions a small increase in one region.
exercises.question: What is the problem with the headline?
options: It exaggerates the scope of the increase

feedbackOnError.explanation: El titular generaliza un aumento pequeño y localizado, exagerando su alcance.

exercises.audioText: It is claimed that the policy has failed, but the evidence comes from an outlet with a clear editorial stance. I'd read between the lines before accepting that framing.
exercises.question: What does the speaker advise?

feedbackOnError.explanation: La recomendación es cuestionar la fuente y el encuadre antes de aceptar la conclusión.

exercises.question: Completa: It ___ that the story was exaggerated.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La pasiva reportativa impersonal es 'It is believed that…'.

exercises.transcription: The headline suggests a crisis but the article tells a different story
exercises.audioText: The headline suggests a crisis but the article tells a different story

feedbackOnError.explanation: Escribe 'headline' como una sola palabra y 'different' con doble 'f'.

exercises.targetPhrase: I'd read between the lines before sharing that.
exercises.audioText: I'd read between the lines before sharing that.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Enlaza 'read between the' y baja la entonación en 'before sharing that'.

exercises.prompt: Analiza un titular ambiguo: distingue el hecho de la interpretación, explica qué se omite y justifica tu lectura.
exercises.modelAnswer: The headline says the city is facing a crisis, but the article only reports a short delay in one service. It is claimed that the problem is widespread, yet the coverage omits the regional context. I'd read between the lines: the framing suggests a systemic failure, while the evidence points to a local incident. Perhaps we should verify the source before sharing it.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo usa pasiva reportativa y atenuadores para analizar el encuadre sin afirmar intenciones ocultas.

lessons.title: Noticias que manipulan
lessons.scenario: Una noticia viral mezcla datos reales con exageraciones; hay que verificar antes de compartir.
lessons.canDo: Puedo evaluar la fiabilidad de una noticia, describir técnicas de manipulación y argumentar con fuentes.

grammarPoints.label: Passive reporting structures
grammarPoints.description: It is said that…, He is believed to…

grammarPoints.label: Nominalization
grammarPoints.description: Convertir acciones en sustantivos para un registro formal.

culturalNotes.note: Presentar algo negativo de forma más agradable de lo que es; en prensa puede ocultar la gravedad de un despido o recorte.

exercises.passage: The report {{b1}} to have been verified, but the {{b2}} of the data was selective.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La pasiva reportativa atribuye la verificación y la nominalización 'presentation' formaliza la crítica.

exercises.passage: The {{b1}} of the story relies on {{b2}} language, and the {{b3}} of the source is never explained.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Las nominalizaciones 'framing', 'selection' y el adjetivo 'sensational' concentran la crítica en el tratamiento informativo.

exercises.instructions: Empareja cada técnica con su efecto.

pairs.left: The clickbait headline promises a shocking secret.
pairs.nuance: Prioriza el clic sobre la precisión.

pairs.left: The story distorts the original data.
pairs.nuance: Cambia el sentido de la evidencia.

pairs.left: They sugarcoat the layoffs as a restructuring.
pairs.nuance: El eufemismo reduce el impacto emocional.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Sensacionalismo, distorsión y eufemismo son estrategias distintas de manipulación.

exercises.instructions: Distingue el registro nominal del verbal.

pairs.left: The implementation of the policy was delayed.
pairs.nuance: Convierte la acción en sustantivo y aumenta la distancia.

pairs.left: They implemented the policy late.
pairs.nuance: Identifica la acción y el agente con claridad.

pairs.left: The verification of claims is essential.
pairs.nuance: Aporta precisión y tono institucional.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La nominalización formaliza el discurso, pero puede ocultar quién realiza la acción.

exercises.audioText: The article is said to be verified, but the headline sugarcoats the layoffs.
exercises.question: What is the contradiction?
options: The article is verified but the headline minimizes the layoffs
The headline is accurate but the article is not

feedbackOnError.explanation: La verificación atribuida contrasta con un titular que suaviza un despido grave.

exercises.audioText: The manipulation is subtle: the story uses a dramatic headline, omits the source and presents correlation as causation. I'd verify it before sharing.
exercises.question: Which techniques does the speaker mention?
options: Dramatic headline, missing source and false causation

feedbackOnError.explanation: El hablante enumera tres técnicas: titular dramático, fuente omitida y correlación presentada como causa.

exercises.question: Completa: It ___ that the figures were distorted.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La estructura impersonal es 'It is alleged that…', con pasiva reportativa.
La pasiva reportativa con infinitivo perfecto es 'was said to have been verified'.

exercises.targetPhrase: They sugarcoated the layoffs in the headline.
exercises.audioText: They sugarcoated the layoffs in the headline.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Enlaza 'sugarcoated the' y pronuncia 'layoffs' con diptongo inicial.

exercises.prompt: Evalúa una noticia viral: describe las técnicas de manipulación, cuestiona la fuente y propone cómo verificarla antes de compartirla.
exercises.modelAnswer: The story is said to be verified, but the presentation of the data is selective and the headline is pure sensationalism. It distorts a correlation as if it proved causation. I'd fact-check the original report, identify the source and compare it with an independent outlet. Otherwise, sharing it would only amplify the manipulation.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo usa nominalizaciones y pasiva reportativa para analizar la manipulación con registro formal.

lessons.title: El elefante en la sala
lessons.scenario: En una comida familiar todos evitan hablar de las fotos que un pariente publicó sin permiso.
lessons.canDo: Puedo nombrar un tema incómodo con tacto, describir tensiones y proponer hablarlo.

grammarPoints.label: Subjunctive mood
grammarPoints.description: I suggest that he be…, It is essential that…

grammarPoints.label: Cleft sentences
grammarPoints.description: What matters is…, It was X that…

culturalNotes.note: Problema evidente que todos evitan mencionar; nombrarlo puede romper la tensión, pero requiere tacto.
culturalNotes.translation: el tema que nadie quiere tocar

exercises.passage: It is essential that we {{b1}} the issue directly, even if it {{b2}} uncomfortable.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Tras 'It is essential that' se usa el subjuntivo 'address'; la concesión 'even if it feels' mantiene el presente.

exercises.passage: What {{b1}} me most is that no one {{b2}} consent before sharing the photos; I suggest that we {{b3}} the conversation today.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La cleft 'What worries me…' focaliza la preocupación; 'suggest that we have' exige subjuntivo.

exercises.instructions: Empareja cada intervención con su estrategia comunicativa.

pairs.left: There's an elephant in the room.
pairs.nuance: Nombra la tensión sin entrar aún en el contenido.

pairs.left: I don't want to make this uncomfortable.
pairs.nuance: Protege a los presentes, pero aplaza el problema.

pairs.left: We need to talk about the photos.
pairs.nuance: Pone el tema sobre la mesa sin rodeos.

feedbackOnError.explanation: El mismo tema puede nombrarse con evasión, tacto o confrontación directa.

exercises.instructions: Distingue la estructura de cada intervención.

pairs.left: It is important that everyone be heard.
pairs.nuance: La forma base 'be' marca distancia y respeto.

pairs.left: What matters is that we respect her privacy.
pairs.nuance: Desplaza el foco al principio ético.

pairs.left: I'd rather we didn't expose the issue publicly.
pairs.nuance: El condicional evita una prohibición directa.

feedbackOnError.explanation: El subjuntivo y la cleft permiten marcar prioridades sin acusar a nadie.

exercises.audioText: We all know there's an elephant in the room, but nobody wants to mention the photos.
exercises.question: What is the speaker referring to?

feedbackOnError.explanation: El modismo señala un tema evidente que todos evitan mencionar.

exercises.audioText: It is essential that we discuss consent before sharing any more family pictures. What worries me is not the photos themselves, but the fact that nobody asked her permission.
exercises.question: What is the speaker's main concern?

feedbackOnError.explanation: La preocupación no son las fotos, sino que nadie pidió permiso.

exercises.question: Completa: It is essential that we ___ the issue directly.

feedbackOnError.explanation: El subjuntivo tras 'It is essential that' usa la forma base 'address'.
Tras 'I suggest that' se usa el subjuntivo 'we discuss', no el pasado.

exercises.targetPhrase: Let's address the elephant in the room.
exercises.audioText: Let's address the elephant in the room.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Enlaza 'address the' y marca el acento de 'elephant' en la primera sílaba.

exercises.prompt: Nombra un tema incómodo en una comida familiar: describe la tensión, propón hablarlo con tacto y protege la privacidad de los implicados.
exercises.modelAnswer: I think we should address the elephant in the room: the photos were shared without consent. What matters is not who posted them first, but that everyone feels safe. I suggest that we speak privately with the person involved and agree on clear boundaries. It is essential that we listen before we confront anyone in front of the family.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo combina subjuntivo y cleft para nombrar el conflicto y priorizar la privacidad.

lessons.title: Debate sobre privacidad
lessons.scenario: Un panel discute los límites de la vigilancia digital; hay que defender derechos y riesgos.
lessons.canDo: Puedo debatir sobre privacidad, matizar riesgos y proponer salvaguardas con registro formal.

grammarPoints.label: Inversion with negative adverbials
grammarPoints.description: Not only…, Under no circumstances…, Rarely…

grammarPoints.label: Hedging
grammarPoints.description: I'm afraid, it seems, perhaps, would.

culturalNotes.note: Objeción de que un primer paso llevará inevitablemente a un extremo peor; conviene acompañarla de evidencia, no usarla como argumento automático.

exercises.passage: Under no circumstances {{b1}} we share personal data without consent, and rarely {{b2}} users read the terms.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Las expresiones negativas al inicio exigen inversión: 'should we' y 'do users'.

exercises.passage: Not only {{b1}} the breach expose names, but it {{b2}} also have revealed locations; it {{b3}} be described as a serious failure.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La inversión 'Not only did…' enfatiza el primer problema; 'may have' y 'could be' añaden cautela.

exercises.instructions: Empareja cada término con su definición en el debate.

pairs.left: The breach exposed sensitive data.
pairs.nuance: Acceso no autorizado a información protegida.

pairs.left: Encryption protects the messages.
pairs.nuance: Convierte el contenido en datos ilegibles sin la clave.

pairs.left: Users can remain anonymous.
pairs.nuance: La identidad no queda vinculada a la actividad.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Filtración, cifrado y anonimato describen riesgos y protecciones distintos.

exercises.instructions: Distingue la objeción de la salvaguarda.

pairs.left: If we accept this, it's a slippery slope.
pairs.nuance: Predice una escalada sin demostrarla.

pairs.left: I'm afraid the regulation may be too broad.
pairs.nuance: Señala un riesgo sin rechazar la norma entera.

pairs.left: Under no circumstances should we weaken encryption.
pairs.nuance: La inversión cierra la posibilidad de concesión.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La atenuación permite criticar una medida, mientras la inversión marca un límite sin matices.

exercises.audioText: Under no circumstances should we weaken encryption; the risk of a breach is too high.
exercises.question: What is the speaker's position?

feedbackOnError.explanation: La inversión negativa expresa una oposición firme a debilitar el cifrado.

exercises.audioText: I'm afraid the proposal may create a slippery slope. Not only would it require more tracking, but it could also undermine anonymity. Perhaps we could set clearer limits before approving it.
exercises.question: What does the speaker propose?

feedbackOnError.explanation: El hablante critica el riesgo y propone límites más claros antes de aprobar la medida.

exercises.question: Completa: Rarely ___ users read the terms before accepting.

feedbackOnError.explanation: 'Rarely' al inicio exige inversión con el auxiliar de presente: 'Rarely do users read…'.

exercises.transcription: Under no circumstances should we share personal data without consent
exercises.audioText: Under no circumstances should we share personal data without consent

feedbackOnError.explanation: Escribe 'circumstances' con 'c' inicial y 'consent' con 's' final.

exercises.prompt: Debate sobre la vigilancia digital: defiende un derecho, matiza un riesgo y propón una salvaguarda concreta.
exercises.modelAnswer: Under no circumstances should companies track users without explicit consent. Not only does this threaten anonymity, but it also increases the impact of any breach. I'm afraid the current regulation is too vague, so perhaps we could require independent audits and clear limits on data retention. That would protect privacy without blocking legitimate security measures.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo combina inversiones negativas con atenuadores para defender una salvaguarda sin sonar dogmática.

grammarPoints.label: Third conditional
grammarPoints.description: Hipótesis pasadas no realizadas.

grammarPoints.label: Past modals of speculation
grammarPoints.description: must have, might have, can't have.

culturalNotes.note: Innovación que transforma las reglas de un ámbito; se usa para señalar un impacto estructural, no una mejora menor.

exercises.passage: If we {{b1}} invested in public transport earlier, the city {{b2}} have reduced emissions sooner.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La third conditional usa 'If we had invested… could have reduced…'.

exercises.passage: The innovation {{b1}} have been a game changer, but it {{b2}} have failed without regulation; if we {{b3}} a clear framework now, we could scale it safely.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Los modales de especulación pasada ('might have been', 'could have failed') evalúan posibilidades; la condición presente usa 'if we set'.

exercises.instructions: Empareja cada valoración con su función.

pairs.left: The trend is likely to continue.
pairs.nuance: Anticipa una evolución sin certeza absoluta.

pairs.left: This could be a game changer.
pairs.nuance: Señala un impacto estructural potencial.

pairs.left: We need a sustainable framework.
pairs.nuance: Propone reglas que puedan mantenerse en el tiempo.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Predicción, cambio radical y marco sostenible describen niveles distintos de impacto.

exercises.instructions: Distingue la deducción de la hipótesis no realizada.

pairs.left: It must have been a mistake.
pairs.nuance: La evidencia hace muy probable la conclusión.

pairs.left: It might have worked.
pairs.nuance: No afirma que ocurriera.

pairs.left: Had we acted sooner, we would have avoided it.
pairs.nuance: La inversión sustituye a 'if' y enfatiza la hipótesis.

feedbackOnError.explanation: 'Must have' expresa deducción, 'might have' posibilidad y la inversión una hipótesis pasada contrafactual.

exercises.audioText: If we had invested in public transport earlier, we could have reduced emissions much sooner.
exercises.question: What does the speaker imply?
options: The city missed an earlier opportunity
Emissions are no longer a problem

feedbackOnError.explanation: La tercera condicional lamenta una inversión que no se hizo a tiempo.

exercises.audioText: The proposal might have been a game changer, but without a clear framework it could have failed. I'd suggest we set measurable goals before scaling it.
exercises.question: What does the speaker recommend?

feedbackOnError.explanation: El hablante reconoce el potencial, pero pide objetivos medibles antes de escalar.

exercises.question: Completa: If we had acted sooner, we ___ have avoided the crisis.

feedbackOnError.explanation: La consecuencia pasada no realizada se expresa con 'could have avoided'.
El modismo 'game changer' se usa como sustantivo compuesto tras 'a'.

exercises.targetPhrase: This could be a game changer for society.
exercises.audioText: This could be a game changer for society.

feedbackOnError.explanation: Enlaza 'game changer' y da énfasis a 'society' al cerrar la propuesta.

exercises.prompt: Presenta una propuesta tecnológica para el foro ciudadano: anticipa consecuencias, evalúa riesgos y cierra con una llamada a la acción.
exercises.modelAnswer: This platform could be a game changer for local participation, but only if we set a sustainable framework. Had we launched it without safeguards, it might have amplified misinformation instead of reducing it. I propose measurable goals, independent oversight and a public review after six months. If we act now, we can turn a promising trend into lasting change.
selfAssessmentCriteria: ¿Cerré con una llamada a la acción?

feedbackOnError.explanation: La respuesta modelo combina tercera condicional y modales de especulación pasada para anticipar riesgos.
